labels.description: Adds the June 2025 G7 statement on a side-by-side approach to Pillar Two and the January 2026 OECD administrative guidance largely exempting U.S.-headquartered companies from Pillar Two, and recasts expected further guidance as adopting that framework.
labels.rationale: criterion 2: new specific developments (G7 statement, January 2026 OECD guidance) are referenced, and criterion 1: they disclose a new mitigating fact that narrows the company's Pillar Two exposure.

labels.description: Only a page-number artifact ("19") falls out of the text; the indirect tax risk factor is otherwise word for word identical.
labels.rationale: Minor: the only difference is a pagination artifact, with no change in substance.

labels.description: The driver of possible new packaging legislation changes from consumers' "increased" concerns about solid waste and environmental responsibility to consumers' "ongoing" concerns.
labels.rationale: criterion 3: the characterization of the underlying risk driver is softened from a rising trend to a continuing one, which is not an identical meaning.

labels.description: The qualifier limiting applicable labeling and ingredient requirements to "environmental or health" laws is removed, so the risk now covers requirements under any current or future laws or regulations.
labels.rationale: criterion 3: the scope of the laws that could trigger labeling, warning or reformulation requirements is widened.

labels.description: "Ingredients or processing" is added to the list of subjects from which the company's litigation claims and legal proceedings arise, alongside a stylistic heading change from "Litigation" to "Litigation claims".
labels.rationale: criterion 1: a new litigation exposure category (ingredients or processing) is disclosed.

labels.description: Only a page-number artifact ("20") falls out of the text; the high-risk legal compliance environment risk factor is otherwise identical.
labels.rationale: Minor: the only difference is a pagination artifact, with no change in substance.

labels.description: The list of laws and regulations the company is subject to changes "product safety" to "product safety and quality", adding product quality regulation as an area of compliance exposure.
labels.rationale: criterion 1 and criterion 3: a new regulatory exposure (product quality) is disclosed, widening the scope of the laws covered.

labels.description: Net operating revenues from operations outside the United States change from $28.7 billion in 2024 to $28.8 billion in 2025, and tariffs are added to the global events that may cause currencies to fluctuate.
labels.rationale: criterion 4: the dollar amount of non-U.S. revenue changes beyond a date roll-forward, and criterion 1: tariffs are named as a new driver of currency risk.
